description: This Java class 'CalendarUtils' provides utility methods for handling recurring calendar events, including parsing recurrence rules, generating recurring dates, adjusting dates, and converting recurrence rules into human-readable formats within the context of the Fineract platform.

classes.name: CalendarUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling calendar recurrence rules, date calculations, and human-readable recurrence descriptions within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: getNextRecurringDate
methods.description: Calculates the next date in a recurrence sequence based on a recurrence rule, seed date, and start date.

methods.name: adjustDate
methods.description: Adjusts a date based on the recurrence frequency, especially for monthly recurrences near month-end.

methods.name: convertToiCal4JCompatibleDate
methods.description: Converts LocalDateTime to iCal4j Date format.

methods.name: getRecurringDates
methods.description: Generates a collection of recurring dates based on a recurrence rule, seed date, and date range.

methods.name: getLocalDateTimeFromICal4JDate
methods.description: Converts an iCal4j Date to LocalDateTime.

methods.name: getMeetingPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Determines the period frequency type (days, weeks, months, years) from a recurrence rule.

methods.name: getRRuleReadable
methods.description: Converts a recurrence rule into a human-readable string.

methods.name: isValidRecurringDate
methods.description: Checks if a given date matches the recurrence rule.

methods.name: getFirstRepaymentMeetingDate
methods.description: Calculates the first repayment meeting date based on a calendar and disbursement date.

methods.name: getNextRepaymentMeetingDate
methods.description: Calculates the next repayment meeting date considering recurrence rules, working days, and skipping logic.
